service.status: Inspect the connected service instance and protocol version.
doctor: Inspect service readiness without opening new device connections.
devices.list: Refresh devices; disconnected mirror sessions may be cleaned up.
devices.capabilities: Refresh and inspect capabilities of one explicit device.
sessions.start: Start or reuse a device session and acquire a persistent client lease.
sessions.list: List sessions and their actual presentation states.
sessions.wait: Wait for a session state within the request deadline.
sessions.leases: List leases owned by the current client.
sessions.release: Release one lease owned by the current client.
sessions.stop: Release this client lease; close the backend only after its last owner leaves.
screen.capture: Capture a presented PNG frame with its geometry and freshness metadata.
input.tap: Tap at screenshot pixels using a current exported frame reference.
input.swipe: Swipe between screenshot pixels and always release the touch.
input.scroll: Scroll by normalized deltas at screenshot pixels.
input.text: Type text without clearing the focused field.
input.key: Press and release a supported named key.
